verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for a Python library and platform like dlt, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only static tutorials with code snippets and a CLI reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The Marimo notebooks are documented for inspecting pipeline data, not for exploring the API reference, so they do not count. No evidence shows an interactive, runnable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
